groups.title: trees 木
groups.note: A tree on the left or below: wood, fruit, things built of timber.

chars.story: A tree whose fruit goes straight into the mouth: an apricot.
A tree hung with small bright fruit: tangerines.
The tree whose fruit gave its name to a colour: orange.
chars.note: Tell apart: 橘 is the tangerine, 橙 the round orange.

chars.parts: 覀 spiky husk + 木 tree
chars.story: A tree hung with spiky husks: chestnuts.
chars.note: 战栗 'to shudder' uses the same character.

chars.story: A tree whose nut is offered to guests: the betel palm.
chars.note: 香槟 'champagne' is a borrowed word. 槟 also appears in the place name Penang, 槟城. 繽 -> 槟: 木 plus 宾, as 賓 became 宾.

chars.story: Wooden poles with a roof laid across: a shed.
Wood that has gone soft and crumbles: rotten.

groups.title: grass 艹
groups.note: Grass on top: plants, reeds, vegetables.

chars.story: A little umbrella-shaped plant that pops up in damp grass: a mushroom.
Tall grass by the water, as tall as a door: a reed.
chars.note: 蘆 became 芦: the complex lower half was replaced by 户.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 氵 water + 亡 lost (sound)
chars.story: Grass and water stretching out of sight: vast and blurred.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 囱 chimney + 心 heart
chars.story: A hollow green stalk like a chimney in the grass: a scallion.
chars.note: The lower half is hard to analyse after simplification; treat it as one shape. 蔥 became 葱.

groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left: water, liquids, sea.

chars.story: Water that cannot keep still: it is boiling.
More water than the vessel can hold: it overflows.
Water that bursts suddenly over an edge: a waterfall.
A storehouse of water so vast it looks dark blue: the open sea.
chars.note: 滄 became 沧: 倉 became 仓.

chars.story: Calm, clear water: a gentle, well-mannered woman.
chars.note: Common in women's names.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 日 sun + 土 earth
chars.story: Dark mud in water that stains cloth black.
chars.note: Meet it mainly in 涅槃 'nirvana'.

groups.title: silk 纟
groups.note: Thread on the left: silk, cloth, ties.

chars.story: Silk thread worked into a picture: embroidery.
chars.note: 糹 on the left of 繡 became 纟.

chars.story: Silk woven all the way round a bolt of cloth: light silk.
chars.note: 綢 became 绸.

chars.story: A man wearing a silk sash: a gentleman of rank.
chars.note: 紳 became 绅.

chars.story: Silk hanging loose and roomy: ample.
chars.note: 绰号 'nickname' is its commonest word. 綽 became 绰.

groups.title: woman 女
groups.note: A woman on the left: family words and feelings once written about women.

chars.story: A woman sick with envy: jealousy.
A woman among trees, wanting every one: greedy.
chars.note: Only seen after 贪.

chars.story: A woman put on show: a crude word for a prostitute.
chars.note: A vulgar insult word (婊子); 妓 is the neutral 'prostitute'.

chars.story: A woman and an omen: the family name Yao, as in Yao Ming.
chars.note: A surname and place-name character.

groups.title: heart 忄
groups.note: A heart on the left: feelings and attitudes.

chars.story: A heart fixed on one bird alone: only that.
chars.note: Mostly written 唯 today; 惟 survives in set phrases.

chars.story: A heart moved by another's blood: sympathy.
chars.note: T恤 is a T-shirt.

chars.story: A heart that has come loose: lax.

groups.title: stone 石
groups.note: A stone on the left: rock, minerals, chemistry.

chars.parts: 石 stone + 圭 jade tablet (sound)
chars.story: Stone from sand, the stuff of computer chips: silicon.
Dark stone lurking at the water line: a reef.
A stone roller that never stops turning: bustling.
chars.note: Almost always in these doubled or paired words.

groups.title: fire 火
groups.note: Fire on the left: heat, melting, shining.

chars.story: Fire blazing on a mountain: a glorious blaze.
chars.note: 燦 became 灿: the right half was replaced by 山.

chars.story: Fire that lets metal take a new shape: it melts.
A flare in the dark that dazzles the eye.

groups.title: insects 虫
groups.note: An insect: bugs, bats, creeping things.

chars.parts: 虫 insect + 黾 toad shape
chars.story: The insect a toad sits waiting for: a fly.
chars.note: 蠅 became 蝇.

chars.story: A flat-winged flier hanging in the dark: a bat.
chars.note: Only in 蝙蝠; the two halves go together.

chars.story: The second half of the bat word: a big fruit bat.
chars.note: In 蝙蝠 the bat is a lucky sign, because 蝠 echoes 福 'luck'.

chars.parts: 罒 eye + 勹 wrap + 虫 insect
chars.story: A big-eyed caterpillar curled up: the old state of Shu.
chars.note: Short name for Sichuan. A place-name character.

groups.title: feet and walking
groups.note: Characters of crouching, creeping and wandering.

chars.story: Feet folded under the body: squat.
Hands and feet splayed flat: lie on the stomach.

chars.parts: 彳 step + 止 foot, twice
chars.story: Two feet on the road, going away for good: migrate.
chars.note: Almost only in 迁徙.

chars.story: Steps going this way and that: wander.
chars.note: Only in 彷徨.

chars.story: A walker stopped dead in the road: held back.
Strolling with nowhere to be: carefree.
chars.note: Only in 逍遥.

groups.title: mound 阝
groups.note: A mound or wall on the left: slopes, steps, gaps.

chars.story: A hole dug in the ground like a well: a pit trap.

chars.parts: 阝 mound + 比 side by side + 土 earth
chars.story: Rows of earthen steps up a mound to the throne.
chars.note: Almost only in 陛下.

chars.parts: 阝 mound + 小 + 日 + 小
chars.story: Light slipping through small gaps in a wall: a crack.

groups.title: words 讠
groups.note: A speech mark on the left: saying, reciting, cursing.

chars.story: Words piled on someone to wish them ill: a curse.
chars.note: 詛 became 诅. Only in 诅咒 'to curse', as the first half of the word.

chars.story: Words spoken aloud in a steady line: recite.
chars.note: 誦 became 诵.

groups.title: blades and spears
groups.note: A knife stroke or a spear: cutting, stabbing, killing.

chars.story: A knife stroke that cuts motion short: brake.
chars.note: Also 'temple', as in 古刹.

chars.story: A blade aimed at the bandits' nest: wipe them out.
A spear jabbed at a bird: poke.
A raised spear and many fallen: slaughter.

groups.title: animals 犭 and kin
groups.note: Beasts, hunting and camels.

chars.story: A dog on guard at the edge of the field: out hunting.
chars.note: Mostly meets it in 狩猎.

chars.story: A small beast prowling by the village: a wild cat.
Hunters with dogs and fire on the northern plain.
chars.note: Also a surname and a transliteration character, as in 狄更斯 Dickens.

chars.story: An ox standing firm on the earth: a male animal.
chars.note: 牡丹 'peony' is its commonest word.

chars.story: A horse-sized beast with a hump: a camel.
chars.note: Also the surname Luo. 駱 became 骆. Only in 骆驼 'camel', as the first half of the word.

groups.title: colour and shine
groups.note: Fine colours and fine patterns.

chars.story: A kingfisher's feather: bright bluish green.
The sky after rain, glowing red: sunset clouds.
A fine piece of jade.
chars.note: Mostly in names and loan words.

chars.story: Writing that is far from plain: elegant.
chars.note: A transliteration character in foreign names.

groups.title: body and illness
groups.note: Bones, sickness and the shaking body.

chars.story: A thousand struck dead: wiped out.
chars.note: 殲 became 歼.

chars.story: What is left of the body: the bones.
The soft stuff inside the bone: marrow.
chars.note: 髓 also means the 'essence' of a thing.

chars.story: An illness that leaves the limbs unable to move.
chars.note: Only in 瘫痪.

chars.story: The head shaking: tremble.
chars.note: 顫 became 颤.

groups.title: looking
groups.note: Eyes searching or fixed.

chars.story: Eyes fixed on one thing: gaze at it.
chars.note: 矚 became 瞩.

chars.story: A hand held out while the eyes look about: seek.
chars.note: 覓 became 觅.

groups.title: tools and containers
groups.note: Things that scrape, hold or cover.

chars.story: A flat piece of metal that scrapes the ground: shovel.
chars.note: 鏟 became 铲.

chars.story: A big clay vessel: a jar or vat.
An upturned bowl worn on the head: a helmet.

chars.parts: - a cloth held open over the lap
chars.story: A cloth gathered up into a bag: a pocket.
chars.note: The strokes have no neat parts; learn it as one picture.

groups.title: people
groups.note: Family, officials and the idle rich.

chars.story: The man on the mother's side: mother's brother.
chars.note: Mother's brother only; the father's brother has other words.

chars.story: One who keeps the records for the state: a petty official.
chars.note: Old-style word, mostly in 官吏.

chars.story: A person with too many things: extravagant.

groups.title: open spaces
groups.note: Wide, clear and open.

chars.story: Tapping open the door of a high hall: spacious.
A valley split wide open: clear and open.
chars.note: Also means 'to exempt'.

chars.story: A figure curled up under a roof, just as if at home.

groups.title: dirt and insult
groups.note: Dung, scorn and quarrels.

chars.story: Rice eaten, and what comes out: dung.
chars.note: 糞 became 粪.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 罒 eye + 戍 guard
chars.story: A guard's eye sweeping down on the grass-low folk: contempt.
chars.note: The pieces are only a loose picture; learn the whole shape.

chars.story: Blood spilled and a rift opened: a quarrel.
chars.note: 釁 became 衅.

groups.title: places and ground
groups.note: Rooms, huts, banks and rough hills.

chars.story: A neat room for writing: a study.
chars.note: Also 'abstinence from meat'. 齋 became 斋.

chars.story: A small roof for a watcher by a fire: a shack.
chars.note: 寮国 is Laos in Taiwan usage.

chars.story: A mountain of odd, uneven shapes: rugged.
chars.note: Often in Japanese place names.

chars.story: Earth heaped up along the water: a dike.

groups.title: one-offs
groups.note: Four characters that belong to nothing else here.

chars.story: An ear hanging down, lingering: dawdle and delay.
chars.note: Also 'to indulge in'.

chars.story: A greenish gas: chlorine.

chars.parts: - a robe with hands busy inside it
chars.story: Hands working inside a robe, helping to dress: assist.
chars.note: Literary. Also a place name, as in 襄阳. The literary word for 助.

chars.story: Quiet woods where monks chant: Buddhist and Sanskrit things.
chars.note: Also in 梵高 Van Gogh.

groups.title: small sounds
groups.note: Mouth sounds and particles.

chars.story: A mouth adding a trailing flourish to a spoken sentence.
chars.note: Mostly a mile (英哩) or in 咖哩 curry (commonly 咖喱).

chars.story: The mouth jerks out a sharp bark: a cough.
A mouth full of happiness: giggle.
The mouth heaves out the contents of the stomach.
chars.note: 嘔 became 呕.

chars.story: A mouth grunting an agreeable "mm".
chars.note: In Cantonese it means 'not'.

groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: A hand on the left: grip, throw, pull.

chars.story: A hand sets a thing down on a shelf: put aside.
chars.note: 擱 became 搁.

chars.story: Holding on with both hands: wholehearted and sincere.
chars.note: 摯 became 挚.

chars.story: A hand reaching into a pocket to fish something out.
A hand splitting things apart: peel and pull open.
chars.note: Also 'to cling to'.

chars.story: A hand testing a prisoner with blows: flog.
chars.note: 拷贝 is also the computing 'copy'.

sentences.en: I love the month of Ramadan.
The train was delayed because of heavy snowfall.

sentences.zh: 他们利用陷阱捕捉狐狸。
sentences.en: Using a trap, they caught the fox.

sentences.zh: 这个小孩穿着一件丝绸织成的肚兜.
sentences.en: The child is wearing a belly-slip made of silk.
